yichen-trash-bag v1.0.0

- Initial release of the yichen-trash-bag skill for e-commerce smart customer service.
- Supports intelligent Q&A and product recommendation for trash bag and household supply shoppers.
- Covers inquiry scenarios: product advice, specs, pricing, promotions, shipping, after-sales, wholesale/OEM.
- Ensures data accuracy by requiring all answers to reference up-to-date info from specific files.
- Delivers responses in a warm, friendly, customer-focused tone suitable for Chinese e-commerce customer service.
- Designed with clear boundaries: consultative role only, no actual order/refund processing.
